messages:
Zoe (DevRel): Heads-up — planning a small hands-on lab next week: a short, opinionated dev tutorial + tiny refapp that shows low-latency inference on Redwood Dedicated. Need blog launch post, benchmark narrative, tutorial repo, webinar, and inbound routing for signups. Who can pick which pieces?

Maria (Marketing): I can own the launch post + social snippets. Need hero bench numbers (p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) and a 2-sentence TL;DR for the top. Also want a short customer-looking quote if we can get one.

Sam (DevRel): I'll run the harness and pull bench graphs — p95 latency, cost/token, throughput vs batch. ETA Tue EOD for initial numbers. Will attach the runbook and raw data.

Priya (Growth): For inbound routing: gated signup -> tag as "mini-lab" in HubSpot, flows: if trial usage > X tokens within 7 days then auto-assign to AE queue; else nurture drip. Can someone confirm the desired threshold? Also we should add UTM params for webinars.

Ken (PM): Product note — call out Dedicated vs Hosted parity and a short section about model variants/quantization tradeoffs. Also confirm we can share the exact GPU types used in benches (we used A10G in staging).

Jess (Ops): I can schedule the webinar and create the registration page. Prefer 45 min slot (15 intro / 20 demo / 10 Q&A). Which day works? I can do Thu or next Tue. Need speaker list and a short speaker blurb for page.

Zoe (DevRel): Proposed agenda + speakers: intro (me) + live demo (Sam) + product roadmap snippet (Ken) + marketing CTA (Maria). Call-to-action: repo + gated sign-up for trial credits. Thu would be ideal.

Maria (Marketing): I'll draft the post and landing copy tonight and post a PR in content repo. Will include 3 social cards and a short benchmark snippet. Please add the images/graphs when ready.

Sam (DevRel): Will push bench artifacts to the shared bucket and link in the PR. Quick example run command I used:```bash
rdctl bench --model redwood-small-v1 --seq 512 --batch 8 --warmup 1000
```Will include config and docker run in the tutorial repo.

Priya (Growth): For HubSpot routing, here's the minimal mapping we'll need (example):```yaml
lead_source: "mini-lab-webinar"
tags: ["mini-lab"]
assign_if: "tokens_used_7d > 100000"
assign_to: "AE_queue_inbound"
```Can someone confirm the "100000" threshold or propose another?

Ken (PM): 100k tokens seems reasonable for a signal threshold. Confirmed that GPU details (A10G) ok to publish.

Jess (Ops): I'll tentatively book Thu 11am PT and mark as tentative until copy + speakers confirmed. Creating calendar + Zoom -> will share link in this thread.

Zoe (DevRel): Small checklist for owners: Maria = post copy & social; Sam = benches + tutorial repo; Priya = routing & form; Ken = product signoff; Jess = webinar logistics. I'll coordinate speaker run-through.

Maria (Marketing): Draft PR: github.com/redwood/content/pull/142 — will ping reviewers when graphs are in. :white_check_mark:

Sam (DevRel): Uploaded bench csvs to gs://redwood-bench/mini-lab/3201234567/ and pushed a preview notebook. Will create a short GIF of the demo run.

Priya (Growth): I'll wire the HubSpot form and webhook once the registration page is live. Also adding UTM templates to the webinar page.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Mini Inference Lab — Thu 11am PT" — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3201234567

Zoe (DevRel): Great — thanks everyone. Will schedule a 30m dry-run Wed morning.

Maria (Marketing): :eyes: will review PR tomorrow AM.

Ken (PM): Approved on product text, small nit about wording on quantization — I'll leave inline comments in the doc.

Jess (Ops): Shared Zoom + registration link in the calendar event. Marked speakers as tentative.

Sam (DevRel): Final bench graphs will be in the PR by Tue 6pm.

Priya (Growth): Once form live I'll wire the routing and confirm AE mapping.

Zoe (DevRel): Awesome — hitting go on dry-run scheduling. Thanks!
